b1-economiasexportacion-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Export Model
b1-economiasexportacion-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Latin America between 1870 and 1914. Carlos asks what the countries sold to Europe.
b1-economiasexportacion-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what Brazil and Colombia exported.
cues: Say what Brazil and Colombia exported
Use a relative clause about the products
b1-economiasexportacion-01.target: El producto que exportaban Brasil y Colombia era el café.
b1-economiasexportacion-01.english: The product that Brazil and Colombia exported was coffee.
b1-economiasexportacion-01.canDo: I can say what the export model was and when it grew.

b1-economiasexportacion-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Coffee and Its Price
b1-economiasexportacion-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are at a museum with a map of export products. Carlos asks what you learned about coffee.
b1-economiasexportacion-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the museum said about coffee.
cues: Say that Brazil was the biggest coffee producer
Say that the price of coffee went up and down
b1-economiasexportacion-02.target: Brasil era el mayor productor de café del mundo. El café, cuyo precio subía y bajaba, era un riesgo.
b1-economiasexportacion-02.english: Brazil was the biggest coffee producer in the world. Coffee, whose price went up and down, was a risk.
b1-economiasexportacion-02.canDo: I can say what Argentina, Brazil, Chile and Central America exported.

b1-economiasexportacion-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Railways and Ports
b1-economiasexportacion-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg watched a documentary about railways in Latin America in the 1800s, and Meg asks what you noticed.
b1-economiasexportacion-03.prompt: Tell Meg what the documentary said about the railways.
cues: Say that the railways joined the ports with the interior
Say that many lines did not join the regions
b1-economiasexportacion-03.target: Aunque los ferrocarriles unían los puertos con el interior, muchas líneas no unían unas regiones con otras.
b1-economiasexportacion-03.english: Although the railways joined the ports with the interior, many lines did not join one region with another.
b1-economiasexportacion-03.canDo: I can say who built and paid for the railways.

b1-economiasexportacion-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Immigrants in Argentina
b1-economiasexportacion-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading a book about Argentina in 1914. Carlos asks what the census showed.
b1-economiasexportacion-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what the 1914 census showed.
cues: Say what share of the population was born abroad
b1-economiasexportacion-04.target: Según el censo de 1914, alrededor del treinta por ciento de la población había nacido en el extranjero.
b1-economiasexportacion-04.english: According to the 1914 census, about thirty per cent of the population had been born abroad.
b1-economiasexportacion-04.canDo: I can explain how debt kept labourers on the hacienda.

b1-economiasexportacion-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The End of Guano
b1-economiasexportacion-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You are telling Meg about a class on Peru in the 1800s.
b1-economiasexportacion-05.prompt: Tell Meg what happened to Peru's guano business in the 1870s.
cues: Say that guano stopped being the big business
Say that the state stopped paying its debt in 1876
b1-economiasexportacion-05.target: El guano dejó de ser el gran negocio del Perú. En 1876 el Estado dejó de pagar la deuda.
b1-economiasexportacion-05.english: Guano stopped being Peru's big business. In 1876 the state stopped paying its debt.
b1-economiasexportacion-05.canDo: I can say when Peru's guano boom happened and how it ended.

b1-economiasexportacion-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Learned About Export Economies
b1-economiasexportacion-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are talking about a class on export economies. Carlos asks what the main problem of the model was.
b1-economiasexportacion-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what the main problem of the model was.
cues: Say that the countries depended on few products
Say what happened when prices fell
b1-economiasexportacion-consolidation.target: Los países que dependían de pocos productos perdían ingresos cuando el precio bajaba.
b1-economiasexportacion-consolidation.english: Countries that depended on few products lost income when the price fell.
b1-economiasexportacion-consolidation.canDo: I can say what the export model was and what Latin American countries sold abroad.
